tasks.label: 检查 MySQL267
args: $client = [Net.Sockets.TcpClient]::new(); try { $connection = $client.ConnectAsync('127.0.0.1', 3306); if (-not $connection.Wait(1500) -or -not $client.Connected) { throw 'unavailable' }; Write-Host 'MySQL267已运行' } catch { Write-Error 'MySQL267未运行'; exit 1 } finally { $client.Dispose() }
